name: SOHiS SRI
author: SOHiS

sections.description:
SOHiS SRI allows you to easily embed the SOHiS hotel reservation system into your WordPress website.

The plugin provides a shortcode that embeds the SOHiS booking page and allows your guests to make hotel reservations directly from your website.

The plugin connects to the SOHiS booking service at https://booking.sohis.pl and uses an iframe to display the booking interface on your WordPress site.

To use the plugin, you need a unique place_id assigned to your hotel. To obtain the required configuration and access to the SOHiS booking service, please contact us:

Email: sprzedaz@sohis.pl
Phone: +48 533 357 221

After your account has been configured, we will provide you with the place_id required by the plugin.

Privacy policy (Polish): https://booking.sohis.pl/other/polityka.pdf

This plugin is based on the iframe implementation by Webvitaly.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the SOHiS SRI plugin.
  2. Contact SOHiS to configure your hotel and obtain your place_id.
  3. Add the [sohis_sri place_id="1"] shortcode to the page or post where you want to display the SOHiS booking system.
  4. Replace 1 with the place_id assigned to your hotel.
  5. Publish or update the page.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

After installing and activating the plugin, add the [sohis_sri place_id="1"] shortcode to the page or post where you want the SOHiS booking system to appear. Replace 1 with the place_id assigned to your hotel.

What is place_id?

The place_id is a unique identifier assigned to your hotel in the SOHiS booking system. It is required to connect the plugin to the correct hotel.

How can I get my place_id?

Please contact SOHiS to set up your hotel and obtain the required place_id.

Email: sprzedaz@sohis.pl
Phone: +48 533 357 221

Where are the reservations managed?

Reservations are processed through the SOHiS booking system. The plugin embeds the SOHiS booking page on your WordPress website.

Does the plugin store reservation data in WordPress?

No. The plugin does not provide its own reservation system. Booking data is handled by the SOHiS booking service.

Can I use the plugin without SOHiS?

No. The plugin requires access to the SOHiS booking service and a valid place_id.

How can I get support?

For configuration, account, or booking system support, please contact SOHiS:

Email: sprzedaz@sohis.pl
Phone: +48 533 357 221
